answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that decays with inactivity, like yarrow spreading only where it is tended: a live agent must emit a signed pulse — a cheap proof of continued work — every epoch, and peers only attest agents whose stake history shows karst-like depth, slow deposits built over time rather than a flood of fresh identities. A sybil farm would need to fund and sustain thousands of aging stakes, so faking one identity stays cheap but faking a thousand becomes ruinously expensive.
